text:
marie: looping in @tessa_hw_partner (Nova) to finalize telemetry schema + perf/W targets for the joint benchmark. Goal: publish a short joint results doc and a reproducible runbook. can you confirm sensor access and any firmware constraints?

marie: we should lock on the telemetry fields (power, tokens/s, p50/p95, gpu_util, mem_bw, kvcache_hit). prefer JSONL export with timestamps. also need to agree on the load levels (30/60/90% sustained) and sequence lengths to test.

tessa_hw_partner: hi all — we have nvml and ipmi on these boards, can surface per-GPU power + rail sensors. NDA already signed last month. firmware is current stable (v2.1.4) but we have a small perf patch v2.1.5 that we can test if you want.

alejandro: +1 on JSONL. proposed matrix: models: small/med/large (7B/13B/70B equiv), seqs: 256/512/1024, concurrency sweep: single-shot / auto-batched (target lat SLOs 50ms p50 for single-shot), sustained runs at target QPS for 10m to get stable power. Metrics: tokens/s, watts (avg, p90), perf_per_watt = tokens/s / watts, energy_per_token = joules/token.

alejandro: quick runner example (for the perf team):
```
bench-run --model open-13B --seq 512 --concurrency 8 --duration 600 --emit-metrics prom://localhost:9090 --export jsonl://results.jsonl
```

sam_g: for export schema we prefer one json object per sample with fields: ts, run_id, model, seq_len, concurrency, tokens_per_sec, p50_ms, p95_ms, avg_watts, peak_watts, gpu_util_pct, mem_bw_gb_s, kvcache_hit_rate. example line:
```
{"ts":"2026-11-12T15:04:05Z","run_id":"nova-197","model":"open-13B","seq":512,"concurrency":8,"tokens_per_sec":1250.3,"p95_ms":182.1,"avg_watts":280.4}
```

tessa_hw_partner: that schema is fine. we can also provide per-rail power (core/vrm) if you want deeper analysis — would add two fields core_watts and vrm_watts. firmware v2.1.5 reduces jitter at high concurrency, worth trying if you can run an A/B.

marie: let's plan an A/B: run baseline v2.1.4 then v2.1.5. schedule proposal: Tue 10:00-12:00 PT for dry-run, Wed 02:00-06:00 PT for official run (to minimize impact on shared infra). @bench-bot can you create the run window and notify ops?

bench-bot: scheduled benchmark window created: Tue 10:00-12:00 PT (dry-run) and Wed 02:00-06:00 PT (official). added alerts to #eng-oncall and pinned the runbook.

alejandro: ops checklist: (1) reserve 4 identical boards (2) pin driver versions and nvml (3) set isolation CPU/memory to avoid background noise (4) collect power logs at 10Hz min. i'll prepare the runner script and a prometheus job to scrape nvml_exporter.

sam_g: data handoff: we'll want raw JSONL + aggregated CSV (per-run) and a short metadata.yaml with run_id, firmware, driver, env, model_hash. share S3 bucket path and retention policy.

tessa_hw_partner: we'll upload raw telemetry to s3://nova-joint-bench/nova-197/ after the official run. we can also stream to your prom if you want live dashboards.

marie: action items:
- alejandro: produce runner scripts + prometheus job (due Mon EOD)
- sam_g: JSONL schema validator and aggregator (due Mon EOD)
- tessa_hw_partner: prepare firmware v2.1.5 images and confirm board list (due Mon EOD)
- bench-bot: confirm alerting and create run windows (done)

marie: once we have data, we'll draft a 1-pg joint summary with perf/W charts and a short methodology appendix. thanks everyone — small, focused benchmark so we can iterate quickly. :thumbsup:
